findings.title: Advertised price agrees across retrieved versions
findings.detail: Both retrieved versions of the exact unit page show $2,995 monthly. This establishes consistency in the supplied snapshots, not a verified lease quote or all-in price.

findings.title: No-fee does not mean no additional costs
findings.detail: The advertiser says there is no broker fee. Deposit, application charges, utilities, insurance and any amenity fees were not established in the retrieved text. Missing amounts are not zero.

findings.title: Availability needs a current confirmation
findings.detail: The retrieved listing advertises immediate move-in. TinyFish could not refresh the candidate pages because access was blocked; Exa did not supply its acquisition date. No manager has confirmed availability.

findings.title: Pet policy is not established
findings.detail: The retrieved page does not establish whether pets are permitted. Silence is not a no-pets rule or permission. Ask management for the unit-specific policy.

findings.title: Official building records not assessed
findings.detail: This report reviews marketplace text only. Complaint and violation records were not queried for this case; no safety or compliance conclusion is drawn.
